name: hud_ui_clamped_int_step_button_on_activate
description: HudUiClampedIntStepButton::OnActivate commits a target clamped integer input, applies a signed step, clamps to bounds, updates the text, invalidates the target, and runs base ZRD activation. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: VC5SP3 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs and VC5SP3 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparisons compile but currently fail; the best reviewed VC5SP3 attempt emits a 128-byte body against the 119-byte Binary Ninja body with 94 unmasked mismatches after masking 16 relocation bytes and trimming 14 trailing VC NOP bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x41a350 validate targetInput null gating, ftable slot 0x8c CommitAndGetValue dispatch, adding self->stepDelta, signed min/max clamp from targetInput offsets 0x374/0x378, sprintf("%d"), HudUiNumericTextInput::Update, ftable slot 0x20 invalidation dispatch, and HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate.

The native clamped-int step button smoke verifies positive stepping clamps to max, negative stepping clamps to min, text/cursor updates through HudUiNumericTextInput::Update, the final target invalidate dispatch occurs once per non-null target, and a null target skips input mutation while still safely activating the base widget.
